First, note that in 1711, time zones were not standardized. However, the question likely assumes modern time zone definitions applied retroactively.  
US/Eastern is UTC-5 (ignoring DST for 1711). Asia/Kolkata is UTC+5:30.  
Difference = UTC+5:30 − (UTC-5) = 10 hours 30 minutes ahead.  
4:00 AM + 10h30m = 14:30 (2:30 PM) same day.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1711-05-10 14:30
